_note: USD. Checked 2026-11-14 against platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing and daytona.io/pricing. Model prices are per million tokens. cache_write is the 5-minute TTL rate; 1-hour writes cost 2x input. Haiku 5.5 bills a whole request at the long_prompt rates when its prompt is over 100,000 tokens. The VM rate is one default sandbox (1 vCPU $0.0504/h, 1 GiB RAM $0.0162/h, 3 GiB disk $0.000108/GiB/h) while running, counting the disk even though the first 5 GiB may be free. Null means unknown; the UI then shows tokens only.
